description: This file defines UI components and layout functions for Summernote's Bootstrap 3 integration, including dialogs, popovers, buttons, and color palettes.

classes.name: ui
classes.description: An object encapsulating UI component creation and layout management functions for Summernote.

methods.name: createLayout
methods.description: Creates and inserts the Summernote editor layout into the DOM, returning references to key elements.

methods.name: removeLayout
methods.description: Removes the Summernote editor layout and restores the original note content.
